messages:
maya: Quick sync — I sketched three launch-readiness scenarios for Console observability (dashboards, trace hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics). Need alignment on acceptance criteria + customer asks before we spin up design/eng work. cc @sam @joni
sam: Nice. Can you paste the scenarios? prefer something we can hand to eng as story-level reqs
joni: TL;DR: Minimal = dashboards + basic error groups; Broad = add trace hooks + per-route cost breakdown; Enterprise = everything + RBAC, PII-redaction, long-term retention controls
luis: For eng: add measurable perf/cost SLOs. e.g. dashboard load <250ms for typical queries, trace hook overhead <5% p99 CPU, and cost delta per 1M tokens < $40 on common workloads
anita: Enterprise customers will ask for KMS integration + opt-out telemetry. Also need clear redaction rules for traces (no user PII).
tom: Ops asks for rollout guardrails: feature-flaggable per-org, canary on 5% traffic, automatic fallback to no-trace path if latency regresses >10% vs baseline
maya: Proposed acceptance criteria snippet (dev-friendly):
```
Minimal: - dashboard templates for top 5 slices - error grouping (stack/hash) - basic per-model cost card - docs + quickstart
Broad: - trace hooks (sampling + span annotations) - per-route and per-model cost breakdown - UIs for toggling sampling & KV cache views - perf telemetry and alerting
Enterprise: - RBAC + org-level retention + KMS hooks - PII redaction pipeline in traces - SLA doc and audit logs
Gating: - e2e canary on sample customers (3) - no perf regressions >10% p95 - UX sanity test with 2 pilot customers
```
sam: +1 on gating. Also add: regression tests for quality (make sure cost UI math matches billing)
joni: We should include a customer-driven ask list and map to scenarios. Example: Acme wants per-endpoint cost, BetaHealth needs PII redaction and longer retention
luis: Engineering estimate ask: can we get rough T-shirt sizes for each scenario? Minimal = M (3w), Broad = L (8-10w), Enterprise = XL (12-16w, infra + compliance)
anita: Security review needs to be in the critical path for Enterprise. Put a hold point before any private key integrations
tom: Rollout plan: feature flag -> canary orgs -> 2-week observation -> gradual ramp with automated rollback triggers. Ops owner: tom, eng lead: luis, PM: maya
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window proposal: 2025-04-12 02:00 UTC (pending approval) :calendar:
maya: Next steps: i'll convert this into a prioritized backlog with stories + acceptance criteria, and schedule a 30m triage with eng/ops/security tomorrow. Anything missing?
sam: Add a small eval harness: synthetic load that simulates 3 customer workloads and verifies cost math + latency before canary
joni: Also require a sample prompts set for quality checks on inferred traces and error grouping (so we don't miss noisy false positives)
maya: Great — I'll add owners & craft the initial sprint plan. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
